autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a foundation builds past its ace

tutorial.foundation: The four foundations start EMPTY. Build each up by suit from Ace to King.
tutorial.tableau: All 52 cards are dealt face-up across 10 columns (two hold 6, eight hold 5). Only the rightmost card of a column can move.
tutorial.moves: One card at a time, onto an ALTERNATING colour one rank lower. An empty column accepts any card.
tutorial.controls: Use hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to the foundation to free up the column.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to unlock buried cards.
